title: MC311: A Multi-City Free-Text Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdiction 311 Classification
description: MC311 is the first public multi-city free-text 311 service-request classification benchmark. It draws about 156,000 citizen-authored complaint narratives from seven US cities (Baton Rouge, Bloomington IN, Richmond VA, Auburn WA, Gainesville FL, Honolulu, San Francisco) and maps 545 native service categories into a shared 14-class civic ontology via an auditable rule set, enabling cross-jurisdiction (leave-one-city-out) evaluation. This deposit contains: (data) the harmonized corpus, the 14-class mapping, the frozen stratified test split and the deduplicated split; (code) the collection, harmonization, evaluation, and analysis scripts; (results) the per-example predictions for every model, the acceptable-set judgments, and the scored results with confidence intervals that regenerate every number in the paper. Raw per-city dumps are not rehosted; they are regenerable from the released collection scripts against each city's open-data portal (see EXTERNAL_DATA.md). Companion to the paper of the same title.
